This page refers to features planned for the Babylon version of the Radix network, coming in September 2023, and may not apply to the current Olympia network version. For more information about the Radix roadmap, click here.

Babylon is a major update to the Radix Public Network coming in September 2023. It marks the addition of powerful, asset-oriented smart contract capability to the Radix Public Network, via the Radix Engine execution environment and the Scrypto smart contract language.

It also includes the introduction of numerous new technologies and concepts. The following articles will get you oriented on Babylon:

Five new platform technologies:

  • What are Smart Accounts?
  • What are Personas (and Identities)?
  • What is Radix Connect?
  • What are Native Assets?
  • What are Transaction Manifests?

Other Babylon concepts and technologies:

  • What is the Radix Wallet for Babylon?
  • What is the Radix Connector browser extension?

‍
